tagline: Tyson Foods. We Feed the World Like Family
hero_kpi_rationale: Operating margin reflects Tyson Foods' core business profitability. In 2025, it stands at 2.0% compared to 2.6% in 2024, impacted by major legal charges ($738M) and impairments.
company_description: Tyson Foods, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a food company worldwide. It operates through four segments: Beef, Pork, Chicken, and Prepared Foods. The company processes live fed cattle and hogs; fabricates dressed beef and pork carcasses into primal and sub-primal meat cuts, as well as case ready beef and pork, and fully cooked meats; raises and processes chickens into fresh, frozen, and value-added chicken products, including breaded chicken strips, nuggets, patties, and other ready-to-fix or fully cooked chicken parts; and supplies poultry breeding stock. It also manufactures and markets frozen and refrigerated food products, including ready-to-eat sandwiches, flame-grilled hamburgers, Philly steaks, pepperoni, bacon, breakfast sausage, turkey, lunchmeat, hot dogs, flour and corn tortilla products, appetizers, snacks, prepared meals, ethnic foods, side dishes, meat dishes, breadsticks, and processed meats under the Tyson, Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm, Ball Park, Wright, Aidells, Gallo Salame, ibp, and State Fair brands. kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from selling food products such as beef, pork, and chicken.
kpis.description: Revenue increased due to higher prices, especially in beef, pork, and prepared foods, but was partially offset by increased legal charges.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined as livestock, pork, and raw material costs increased sharply.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure due to input costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin stands at 2.0% in 2025 ($1,098M / $54,441M) compared to 2.6% in 2024 ($1,409M / $53,309M), impacted by $738M in legal charges and $343M in impairments.
kpis.signal: Margin down in 2025 despite higher sales.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Approximately 133,000 employees as of September 27, 2025. The company has undertaken plant closures and restructurings as part of its network optimization plan.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount, occasional adjustments through restructurings.

kpis.name: Restructuring Charges
kpis.explanation: Costs related to plant closures and workforce reductions.
kpis.description: $45 million in charges in 2025 related to site closures and departures, as part of the global network optimization plan.

kpis.name: Legal Contingency Accruals
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential legal risks.
kpis.description: $738 million in legal provisions in 2025, compared to $182 million in 2024, significantly impacting operating income.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $54.441B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.474B for the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.51 for the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders through dividends of $0.697B for the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 147.0% for the last year.

kpis.name: Beef Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the beef segment, which suffers from cattle shortage and high costs.
kpis.description: Beef segment operating margin was negative at -5.2% in 2025, impacted by high cattle costs with an increase of approximately $1,840M in cattle costs.

kpis.name: Chicken Segment Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability of the chicken segment, which benefits from reduced feed costs.
kpis.description: The chicken segment achieved an operating margin of 8.5% in 2025, driven by a decrease of approximately $340M in poultry feed costs.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Shows the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
